diplomatic_dialogue.multi_court_table_narration: Sire, this settlement of France vs Britain seats 3 courts at the table. Sire, Austria will not sign; the settlement of France vs Britain cannot be ratified until that court is eased toward terms or dropped to fight on.

options.label: Make peace with Britain only
options.description: Leave the joint settlement and make peace with Britain alone; the other courts stay at war.
options.talleyrand_text: Sire, since the larger settlement of France vs Austria + Britain + Russia cannot ratify, I shall open a separate bilateral peace with Britain; the other hostile pairs remain at war until they are addressed in turn.

options.label: Armistice with Britain only
options.description: Leave the joint settlement for an armistice with Britain alone; the war continues elsewhere.
options.talleyrand_text: Sire, an armistice with Britain buys quiet on that front while France vs Austria + Britain + Russia continues elsewhere; it does not end the war, but it does end the bleeding.
